name: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Curl
steps: Sit tall on a bench with dumbbells at your sides and your thumbs facing forward.
Bend your elbows to curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders without turning your palms.
Lower the dumbbells until your arms hang beside you.
tips: Keep your upper arms still through the curl.
Keep your wrists neutral and torso upright without rocking backward.
